query: Walk me through onboarding a new hire into our Vaultwarden org end to end: the account, the org membership and read access to the Infra collection.

Someone leaves the company tomorrow. Give me the full offboarding runbook for Vaultwarden: block the account, revoke the org membership, list what has to be rotated, with the calls in the right order.
Покажи пример полного сценария выдачи секретов из Vaultwarden в CI-пайплайн, чтобы пароли не попадали в лог.
Give me a step-by-step runbook for backing up Vaultwarden and upgrading to a new release without breaking the bw CLI and the mobile apps.
Нужен пошаговый пример оффбординга сотрудника в Vaultwarden: заблокировать аккаунт, отозвать членство в организации, затем составить список паролей на ротацию.
I want an end-to-end example that combines the admin panel, the client API and bw: invite someone to the org, then confirm them after they accept.
What does a cron job look like that reads database credentials from Vaultwarden at run time with its own service account?
Is there a worked example of rolling back a failed Vaultwarden upgrade, restoring the data folder and the previous image?
What is the bw command to delete an item permanently instead of sending it to the trash?
Which admin route forces every client to resync?
Invitation emails from our Vaultwarden never arrive. Where do I look?
What arguments does python-vaultwarden's VaultwardenAdminClient take?
Is it okay to keep the master password in an environment variable of my script?
Which MCP server fits Vaultwarden better: warden-mcp or the official Bitwarden one?
Show me an end-to-end onboarding example for a new employee in Keycloak with groups and roles.
Show me a GitHub Actions example that injects secrets from HashiCorp Vault into a deploy job.
